data.name: A Whittle Tale
data.detailed_description:
Important Settings:


-Difficulty: Directly controls the amount of times a player can get hit before dying. 1 hit death is the default setting.
-Show Landing Indicator: Displays a landing/position indicator when jumping or falling to assist in jumping between platforms. This is disabled by default.
-Controller Auto Rotation Mode and Delay: Controls whether or not the camera will automatically follow the player rotation as the player moves. This can be fully disabled and is always disabled if a controller is not being used.
-Rotation Lag Speed: Controls how quickly the camera rotation takes to reach the desired rotation.


For support, questions or feedback about the demo, feel free to reach out on the Mangy Goblin website!


A Whittle Tale is a charming yet darkly whimsical level-based 3D platformer starring Whittle, a misunderstood young demon who means well but can’t seem to catch a break. Bullied by both angels and demons, Whittle’s troubles begin when a prank by a group of angels goes wrong — they summon him into a heavenly classroom, and in his frantic escape back through the portal, it closes too soon… leaving his tail behind.




Determined to reclaim what he’s lost, Whittle sets out across realms connected by the River Styx, now amusingly modernized thanks to Charon’s laziness in his old age. Too tired to ferry souls himself, Charon has installed coin-operated self-service boats, forcing travelers to collect Obal coins to activate them and journey between realms.


Each realm offers unique environments, collectible challenges, and handcrafted aesthetics — Whittle, his enemies, and the world itself are brought to life through whittled wood, antique toys, and spare parts, creating a distinctive tactile charm. Along the way, Whittle improvises with makeshift prosthetic tails, each granting new abilities and gameplay twists that help him overcome obstacles and inch closer to the heavenly realm — and his true tail.


Blending dark humor, heart, and polished platforming, A Whittle Tale combines the playful accessibility delivering an experience that’s as funny and endearing as it is imaginative and visually striking.

data.short_description: A Whittle Tale is a whimsical 3D platformer where you jump, glide, and swap ability-granting prosthetic tails to overcome handcrafted wooden worlds and collect Obal coins to travel between realms.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit / Windows® 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600 / Intel® Core™ i5-8400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 5600 XT / NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you do not meet the minimum requirements, please feel free to give the game a try and let us know how it runs!
